title: MCP tool-call policy: what it uses
lede: One arrow for each component this feature lists. The steps reuse the feature's own "how it works" text; nothing here is a new claim. Internal and confidential: this text comes from an internal Ping deck and has not been tested on our tenant.

steps.title: Agent Privilege gateway
steps.what: The gateway allows or denies MCP tool calls by tool name according to the app's policy.
steps.why: Customers need to stop an agent's dangerous tool actions even when a tool server is poisoned.

steps.title: Hostile MCP server
steps.what: In one side-by-side test, two identical hostile MCP servers sat behind two apps: a governed one whose policy permits every tool except three dangerous ones, and an ungoverned one with an explicit allow-all policy.
steps.why: Customers need to stop an agent's dangerous tool actions even when a tool server is poisoned.
